question: Could you tell me the number of orders, average payment per order and customer lifespan in weeks of the 3 custumers with the highest average payment per order, where the lifespan is calculated by subtracting the earliest purchase date from the latest purchase date in days, dividing by seven, and if the result is less than seven days, setting it to 1.0?
sql:
WITH customer_order_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_id,
        SUM(op.payment_value) AS order_total_payment
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_orders,
        AVG(order_total_payment) AS avg_payment_per_order
    FROM customer_order_payments
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM customer_stats
    ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
customer_lifespans AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS earliest_purchase,
        MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS latest_purchase,
        CASE 
            WHEN CAST(date_diff('day', CAST(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DOUBLE) / 7.0 < 7.0 THEN 1.0
            ELSE CAST(date_diff('day', CAST(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DOUBLE) / 7.0
        END AS lifespan_weeks
    FROM orders o
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    t.customer_id,
    t.num_orders,
    ROUND(t.avg_payment_per_order, 2) AS avg_payment_per_order,
    ROUND(cl.lifespan_weeks, 2) AS lifespan_weeks
FROM top3 t
JOIN customer_lifespans cl ON t.customer_id = cl.customer_id
ORDER BY t.avg_payment_per_order DESC;
